Astrologer Michael Nnebe Jr., the Peace Dealer, joins me to look back on the astrology of 2024 and ahead to the transits coming next. We get into his Jupiter return, Pluto crossing into Aquarius at the very minute of a family milestone, why the zodiac signs are not the same thing as the constellations, the old mystery teachings hiding inside modern cosmology, and the practical line between your legal name and your private life.
